summary: Andorra's government says the Principality does not require any type of visa and is not a member of the Schengen Area: access is through France or Spain, and third-country nationals who need a Schengen visa must apply for a double-entry or multiple-entry one. The Government of Canada says Andorra has no airport and that you will have to meet the entry, exit and visa requirements for France or Spain.

Fully exempt: stays of Andorran residents, stays of under-16s, and the days beyond 7 of a stay of more than 7 days in the same accommodation.

source.name: Consell General d'Andorra (BOPA 22 June 2022, núm. 76) — Llei 19/2022 reguladora de l'impost sobre les estades en allotjaments turístics

levies.feeText: Euros per day of stay or fraction, by type of accommodation: 5-star tourist accommodation 3.00; 4-star or 4-ear (espigues) tourist accommodation 2.00; tourist-use dwellings 2.00; 2- or 3-star or 2- or 3-ear tourist accommodation, or accommodation being classified, 1.50; other tourist accommodation 1.00.
